data.description: Container ordered-list rendered as a vertical timeline. Each <li> becomes one event.

data-aed-variant.description: Two-column layout (alternating left/right). Defaults to single-column.

data-when.description: Date / time label rendered in the gutter (free-form string).

data-aed-tl-state.description: Visual state. 'done' = filled dot, 'muted' = gray, 'alert' = warning color.
